title: Ballot candidate roster
description: Fills in verified candidate names (and any missing ballot-question titles) for every contest parsed from a sample ballot, as a single paste-back tree.

variables.name: elections
variables.description: One entry per imported election: `name`, optional `electionDay`, `ballotStyle`, `partyContext`, plus `contests[]` and `questions[]` with `displayText` and optional `votingInstruction`.

variables.name: officialSourceUrl
variables.description: Official sample-ballot page the parse came from.

usage.notes: Uses its own roster-specific paste-back contract instead of the shared partial. A blank line follows every election block, including after the last one.
